m: Pat the rind bone dry (leave it uncovered in the fridge overnight if you can). Score it, rub with oil and plenty of salt.
Roast at 240°C for 30 minutes until the rind blisters, then drop to 170°C for 2 hours.
Cut the veg into chunks, toss in oil and salt, and roast below the pork for the last hour.
If the crackling isn't crunchy, put the pork under the grill for 5 minutes and watch it closely.
Rest the pork 15 minutes. Gravy: pan juices plus stock powder dissolved in water, thickened with cornflour mixed into a little cold water.
Slaw: shredded cabbage and apple matchsticks tossed with mayo, a squeeze of lemon if you have one, and salt.
l: Pork and veg together, gravy in a little container. Pork and slaw rolls work well too.
g: Use 100% maize cornflour (not "wheaten") and check the stock powder. Everything else is naturally GF.
